annotations.title: Sitemap parser, URL extractor: documentation URLs from a bounded XML sitemap

description: Sitemap parser: reads one public XML sitemap or sitemap index as structured URLs and source-reported dates. Supports gzip, substring filtering and pagination. Large sitemaps are read from the start (512 KiB, 1000 entries at most, with a warning). Does not crawl pages or follow child sitemaps. Invalid XML and execution errors are not charged; a valid empty match is charged. Use to find which pages of a docs site to read before calling /extract. Example: url=https://www.sitemaps.org/sitemap.xml. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

contains.description: Optional case-insensitive URL substring, at most 200 characters

maxUrls.description: Reported matching locations examined in one page (1-100, default 25); invalid/nonpublic locations may reduce returned entries

offset.description: Offset into distinct reported matching locations (0-1000, default 0); use nextOffset to continue

url.description: Absolute public HTTP(S) XML sitemap URL; child sitemaps are not fetched automatically

name: sitemap

lastModified.description: Source-reported value; not a verified modification time.

matchingReportedLocations.description: Distinct reported locations matching contains, before public-URL validation of the selected page.
